svg.title: D4 — Find resources with inline metrics and schema
svg.desc: A Find resources field contains sam. The list beneath shows samples as a Table with six rows and 96 value-payload bytes at revision 42; sample_notes as a Document with 12 KiB encoded state and a declared map of title text and sections list; and sample_cache as KV with an estimated 1.3k keys, unavailable size and bytes-to-bytes encoding. The Table schema shows id INT64 primary key and value INT64 nullable. Browsing leaves the SQL and three-row result unchanged. All observations are synthetic; the search, metadata summaries and UI are proposed.
